shield_boss_start.speaker: Boomer
shield_boss_start.text: Shield Boss? How's it going friend?

shield_boss_start.speaker: Shield Boss
shield_boss_start.text: Hello Boomer. I just found this neat little Aglet lying around. What do you think?

shield_boss_start.speaker: Boomer
shield_boss_start.text: You found the Aglet? Great! Lets get out of here.

shield_boss_start.speaker: Shield Boss
shield_boss_start.text: And what, let you destroy it? I don't think so. It's about time for you to be dealt with.

shield_boss_phase_2.speaker: Shield Boss
shield_boss_phase_2.text: You have worn me down and completed phase one of my attacks.

shield_boss_phase_2.speaker: Boomer
shield_boss_phase_2.text: Shield Boss, my old friend! I trusted you. How could you do this?!

shield_boss_phase_2.speaker: Boomer
shield_boss_phase_2.text: Please.. there's still time for you. Give me the anglet.

shield_boss_phase_2.speaker: Shield Boss
shield_boss_phase_2.text: ....well, Ok you've convinced me. I'm still your friend. Here you go....

shield_boss_phase_2.speaker: Shield Boss
shield_boss_phase_2.text: SIKE! You can TRUST NO ONE!

shield_boss_phase_2_attempted.speaker: Shield Boss
shield_boss_phase_2_attempted.text: You have worn me down and completed phase one of my attacks.

shield_boss_end.speaker: Boomer
shield_boss_end.text: Sorry friend, you made me do this

shield_boss_end.speaker: Boomer
shield_boss_end.text: Wait, where did the Aglet go?

boomerang_boss_start.speaker: Boomer
boomerang_boss_start.text: Finally the Aglet! Now I can get all that I've ever wanted.

boomerang_boss_start.speaker: Boomer
boomerang_boss_start.text: Wait no... I'm doing this to protect people.

boomerang_boss_phase_2.speaker: Corrupted Boomer
boomerang_boss_phase_2.text: Accept the power! It is everything you've ever wanted.

boomerang_boss_phase_2.speaker: Boomer
boomerang_boss_phase_2.text: No, I only want peace. No way am I using this power. I'm going to destroy it like I set out to do.

boomerang_boss_phase_2_attempted.speaker: Corrupted Boomer
boomerang_boss_phase_2_attempted.text: Accept the power! It is everything you've ever wanted.

boomerang_boss_end.speaker: Boomer
boomerang_boss_end.text: I guess in the end I could *looks at camera* TRUST NO ONE.

boomerang_boss_end.speaker: Boomer
boomerang_boss_end.text: Welp, time to destroy it like I set out to do.
